tickets.title: Homepage banner reports one extra day live
tickets.description: PG-0042 banner scheduled for 15 days reported 16 in the content report. Root cause: Math.ceil on elapsed/MS_PER_DAY; the publish queue unschedules a few hundred ms after midnight, so 15.0048 ceiled to 16. Fixed by flooring per CLAUDE.md guidance.

tickets.title: Add draft/publish diff for content blocks
tickets.description: Editors cannot see which blocks changed between draft and published versions of a page. Add a diff that walks the draft vs published block trees, matches blocks by id, and attaches the changed-block set. renderPreview does not exist yet; create it as a pure function: renderPreview(page, draftTree, publishedTree) returns {...page, blocks: draftTree, changedBlocks: diffBlocks(publishedTree, draftTree)}. Trees are passed as arguments; do not change how pages are stored.
acceptance: lib/diff.js walks draft vs published block trees, matched by block id
lib/pages.js gains renderPreview(page, draftTree, publishedTree), a pure function that attaches the changed-block set
tests cover add, remove, reorder, nested blocks
no change to publish-path behavior or page storage

tickets.title: Reconcile request: PG-0203 drift above threshold
tickets.description: Weekly drift report flags PG-0203 at 2.9% draft/published drift. Within the 5% auto-reconcile policy. Run the standard reconcile procedure and attach the before/after summary.

tickets.title: Preview crashes on blocks with empty titles
tickets.description: renderPreview throws when a block title is an empty or whitespace-only string. Guard it: treat empty/whitespace titles as 'Untitled' and never throw. No change to publish-path behavior.
acceptance: lib/blocks.js treats empty or whitespace-only titles as 'Untitled' without throwing

tickets.title: Page summary: include block count and last-modified
tickets.description: The page summary used by the content report should include the page's block count and the timestamp of its most recent edit (from data/<pageId>-edits.json).
acceptance: lib/pages.js exposes a summary that includes blockCount and lastModified
lastModified comes from the newest entry in the page's edits file; pages with no edits report null
tests cover a page with edits and a page without

tickets.title: Content report: reconcile history per page
tickets.description: The weekly content report should show, per page, when it was last reconciled and what drift was corrected, read from the .reconcile-history/ snapshots the /reconcile procedure writes. Pages never reconciled are listed as such. Handle a missing .reconcile-history/ directory.
acceptance: lib/report.js reads .reconcile-history/ and returns {pageId, when, driftCorrected} per page
missing .reconcile-history/ directory yields an empty report, no throw
